g.text: Sprint 2 - Apply to a research opportunity
SELECT application by student and opportunity
Validate student profile and application rules
Issue #3 — implemented data-access flow to apply for an opportunity
Create pending Application with resumeFileId snapshot
Validate open post, owner/purpose, unique student/post
CONFLICT for duplicate; otherwise validation/storage error
The saved resume reference is immutable.
Replacing the student's current resume does not change this application.
Referenced files cannot be deleted; file bytes are managed separately.
